known_text: Did you watch a bit of television?

use.known: Did you watch a bit of television after work yesterday?
use.target: 你昨天工作以后看了一点电视吗？

use.known: She asked if you want to watch something with her tonight.
use.target: 她问你是不是想今天晚上和她看东西。

use.known: If you have time, you should relax and watch something.
use.target: 如果你有时间，你要放松看东西。

use.known: I hope you had a good time watching with your friends.
use.target: 我希望你和你朋友看的时候过得好。

use.known: Everyone said they want to watch something with you.
use.target: 大家都说他们想和你看东西。

use.known: Did anyone ask you what you watched last night?
use.target: 有人问你昨天晚上看了什么吗？

use.known: Did you watch anything interesting on television last night?
use.target: 你昨天晚上看了有意思的东西吗？

use.known: She wants to watch something with us tomorrow evening.
use.target: 她想明天晚上和我们看东西。

use.known: If you watch for a while, you will feel more relaxed.
use.target: 如果你看一会儿，你会觉得更放松。

use.known: I like to watch something in the evening to relax.
use.target: 我喜欢晚上看东西放松。

use.known: Everyone wants to watch something together on Sunday.
use.target: 大家都想星期天一起看东西。

use.known: Did they tell you what they watched together last week?
use.target: 他们告诉你他们上星期一起看了什么吗？

use.known: Did you watch a bit of television and then go to sleep?
use.target: 你看了一点东西然后去睡觉了吗？

use.known: She told me she already watched everything we have.
use.target: 她告诉我她已经看了我们有的一切。

use.known: If you already watched it, you don't need to watch again.
use.target: 如果你已经看了，你不需要再看。

use.known: I already finished everything I wanted to watch yesterday.
use.target: 我昨天已经完成了我想看的一切。

use.known: Everyone said they already watched it last weekend.
use.target: 大家都说他们上周末已经看了。

use.known: Did you know I watched something interesting last night?
use.target: 你知道我昨天晚上看了有意思的东西吗？

use.known: Did you watch a bit of something to relax last night?
use.target: 你昨天晚上看了一点东西放松吗？

use.known: She said she wants to rest for a bit before going out.
use.target: 她说她想出去之前放松一点。

use.known: If you drink a bit of water, you will feel better.
use.target: 如果你喝一点水，你会觉得好一些。

use.known: I only had a bit of time to watch yesterday evening.
use.target: 我昨天晚上只有一点时间看。

use.known: Everyone had a bit of time to relax this weekend.
use.target: 大家这个周末都有一点时间放松。

use.known: Did you have a bit of time to relax on Sunday?
use.target: 你星期天有一点时间放松吗？

use.known: Did you watch a bit of television before going to sleep?
use.target: 你睡觉之前看了一点电视吗？

use.known: She likes to watch television in the evening to relax.
use.target: 她喜欢晚上看电视放松。

use.known: If you don't have anything to do, you can watch TV.
use.target: 如果你没有东西做，你可以看电视。

use.known: I watched a bit of television on Sunday and relaxed.
use.target: 我星期天看了一点电视，放松了。

use.known: Everyone in the family likes to watch television together.
use.target: 家里大家都喜欢一起看电视。

use.known: Did they tell you they watched television all evening?
use.target: 他们告诉你他们一整个晚上看电视了吗？

use.known: Did you watch a bit of television with your friends?
use.target: 你和你朋友看了一点电视吗？

use.known: She asked if everyone had a good time at the weekend.
use.target: 她问大家周末过得开心吗？

use.known: If you ask nicely, they will probably help you with it.
use.target: 如果你好好问，他们可能会帮你。

use.known: I want to ask if they had time to relax this week.
use.target: 我想问他们这个星期有时间放松吗？

use.known: Everyone is asking if we finished the work on time.
use.target: 大家都在问我们按时完成了工作吗？

use.known: Did anyone ask if the meeting went well yesterday?
use.target: 有人问昨天开会过得好吗？
